crossRefs.note: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

translations.web: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”
translations.bsb: And the elders and the people all said, “Do not listen to him or consent to his terms.”
translations.kjv: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
translations.asv: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken thou not, neither consent.
